title: fix(sinker): judge body electrodes against cavity outlines
body:
## What changed

It adds `cavity_outline` to Sinker Burn parameters.
The points use coordinates relative to the burn point.
The project file, operation digest and MCP tools carry the outline.
An empty outline keeps the previous extent law.

The size law compares the electrode with inward cavity wall offsets.
It permits the derived diamond finish electrode.
It still refuses an oversized electrode by name.
It also refuses malformed outlines, contradictory dimensions and an incomplete finish.
Command creation checks the outline and its stated dimensions.
Generation repeats the bounds checks.
The existing scalar law keeps the floor and condition checks.

The MCP schema declares an optional array with a `null` default.
The electrode reply supplies an array for a body and `null` for a rectangle.
A `null` params patch clears the outline.
The independent stock verdict still checks the actual burn.
Two legacy-extent tests generate box burns and check the corner gouges.

The undercut stock check uses exact disc-polygon intersection.
It blocks a plunge or retract when the cutter head meets a stock corner.
The lollipop profile draws the full ball united with the neck.
The record law now refuses a lollipop neck that ends below the ball top.
The refusal names the lollipop, neck length and required ball height.
The shortest accepted stack includes the whole ball.
The drawn-cutter length remains the stated flute length plus neck length.

## UI screenshots

These inherited parent renders use the headless `ShellUi` (`1440x960` WGPU).
The before views show upstream `5ed5b7fe2`.
The after views come from parent PR #2714.
The pictured UI files are unchanged in #2836.
The images are stored only on `mkinney/Camcraft` branch `pr-screenshots`, at commit `0fd64401cc4acd068a1ec9e048417002176a3f86`:

| View | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Tool editor (`DT-20-60` dovetail cutter) | ![Tool editor before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/0fd64401cc4acd068a1ec9e048417002176a3f86/2714/tool-editor-before.png) | ![Tool editor after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/0fd64401cc4acd068a1ec9e048417002176a3f86/2714/tool-editor-after.png) |
| Slot Undercut page (`TSlot` in milling setup) | ![Slot Undercut before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/0fd64401cc4acd068a1ec9e048417002176a3f86/2714/slot-undercut-before.png) | ![Slot Undercut after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/0fd64401cc4acd068a1ec9e048417002176a3f86/2714/slot-undercut-after.png) |

## Cause

The previous law judged X and Y extents.
An inward offset moves a sharp diamond corner farther than the condition's undersize.
The correct finish electrode then failed the extent check.
The original pin reported a burned X extent of `19.962` for a `20.000` cavity.

## Tests

The original pin failed before the production change:

- `a_diamond_cavity_finish_is_generated_and_judged_clean`

The MCP pin covers schema discovery, translated outlines, generation, null clearing and early refusals:

- `mcp_exposes_the_cavity_outline_and_burns_a_diamond_finish`

The ten motion pins pass:

- `a_diamond_finish_is_judged_on_wall_offsets`
- `matching_extents_do_not_hide_an_oversized_electrode_outline`
- `a_finish_that_leaves_a_wall_undersize_is_refused`
- `malformed_cavity_outlines_are_refused_by_name`
- `an_excessive_cavity_outline_is_refused_before_geometry`
- `a_cavity_outline_that_collapses_on_the_geometry_lattice_is_refused`
- `cavity_outline_extents_must_match_the_stated_size`
- `an_undersize_that_consumes_the_cavity_is_refused`
- `a_small_electrode_cannot_hide_a_gap_that_burns_past_the_floor`
- `a_vector_orbit_does_not_certify_angled_walls`

Each mutation failed its pin with the old code or the guard removed.
Each pin passed after restoration:

- `old-generator`: red / green.
- `shape-point-limit`: red / green.
- `region-lattice`: red / green.
- `extentmatch`: red / green.
- `consumed-inset`: red / green.
- `scalar-floor`: red / green.
- `vector`: red / green.
- `containment`: red / green.
- `finish-coverage`: red / green.
- `early-shape`: red / green.
- `missing-electrode`: red / green.
- `early-size`: red / green.

## Validation

The quick gate started against `upstream/main` at `64b7377297c95d1614c93835c1a1bef18c6de174`.
The heavy gate started against `e313aa663869561b2748b9a0c5dac295470c8667`.
Other sessions updated the shared upstream reference while these gates ran.
The latest observed upstream head is `bd2b774a886796630365bac64069f4c7afd3ba5f`.
These bases retain merge-base `998c918bb04177c45a00396337b095e468acf4b8`.
The final rerun and plan check used `bd2b774a886796630365bac64069f4c7afd3ba5f`.
The ordered quick and heavy plans match the executed plans: 693 and 241 steps.
The 32 changed-file paths are identical across these bases.
The trial merge is clean. This round does not merge main.
PR #2714 merged at `c9410977a`.
Main's protected-item `cap: false` and conservative cylinder bound are retained.

Earlier evidence on `4ed23c5c7f3a5b53a8316604ea0e78cf4a4ae116`:

- The author quick gate passed 693 steps. Clippy passed for tools, sim, motion, app and UI.
- The reviewer quick gate passed 710 steps. The reviewer heavy gate passed 244 steps with no unexpected failure.
- The reviewer completed all six `shared_face_bodies_finish` bands.
- The reviewer mutations checked disc-edge intersection, electrode containment, the normal lollipop drawing and rectangular electrode stock removal.
- The two legacy box-burn pins passed. Removing the outline clears or suppressing rectangular stock removal made the pins fail.

This round checks the short-neck record from the latest review.
A 10 mm ball with a 5 mm flute length needs at least a 5 mm neck length.
The reported 2 mm neck is refused before the analytic head can be used.
A neck that reaches the ball-neck intersection but ends below the pole is also refused.
The exact 5 mm boundary remains accepted.

The pins are:

- `a_lollipop_stack_that_ends_inside_the_ball_is_refused_by_name`: the reported neck, a neck above the intersection, and a neck just below the pole.
- `the_drawn_lollipop_is_the_whole_ball_united_with_the_neck`: the shortest accepted stack and the normal long stack.
- `a_lollipop_drawn_cutter_still_ends_at_the_stated_stack_top`: the unchanged drawn-cutter length law.
- `the_fixture_stack_carries_the_whole_ball_and_keeps_the_neck_top`: the shortest accepted fixture stack.

Final-head validation on `009b6da193713cda0cee0ab7ff37306896828923`:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 693 selected steps. All have a final-head pass.
- The first run took 103.5 minutes. It passed 691 steps and failed two.
- `app suites: example_catalog` initially passed 31 tests, failed two and ignored two. Two adaptive tests reached their 60-second deadline during CPU contention.
- `ui suites: lib` initially stopped with SIGSEGV and no named failed test. This matches the intermittent fault in #2807.
- `CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=4 cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --failed gate-logs/quick-20261122-200252`: both failed steps passed in 3.9 minutes. Heavy work and clippy had completed before this rerun.
- The isolated catalog rerun passed 33 tests, failed zero and ignored two. The tests took 26.23 seconds.
- The isolated UI library rerun passed 1402 tests, failed zero and ignored seven. The tests took 131.51 seconds.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`: 241 steps, zero unexpected failures, 106.2 minutes, exit 0.
- The heavy plan has one release build, 37 motion steps and 203 app steps.
- All six `shared_face_bodies_finish` bands passed, including bands 4 and 6. The suite took 2189 seconds.
- Six known-fail checks produced the expected failures: three for #1950 and three for #2849.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-tools -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean, exit 0, 3 minutes 2 seconds.
- `motion suites: golden_undercut`: four CL golden tests passed.
- `example_catalog_adaptive` and `example_catalog_edge_work`: one test passed in each suite.
- The heavy stock-engine agreement golden checks passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-tools --lib`: 112 passed, zero failed.

Independent mutation proof:

| Mutation | Pin | Mutated | Restored |
|---|---|---|---|
| Remove the new short-stack sanity guard | `a_lollipop_stack_that_ends_inside_the_ball_is_refused_by_name` | RED, exit 101 | GREEN, exit 0 |
| Clip the lollipop drawing at the flute top | `the_drawn_lollipop_is_the_whole_ball_united_with_the_neck` | RED, exit 101; Z 8 draws radius 2 | GREEN, exit 0 |
| Remove the drawn-cutter length guard | `a_lollipop_drawn_cutter_still_ends_at_the_stated_stack_top` | RED, exit 101 | GREEN, exit 0 |

Each production mutation was restored before the final commit and gates.
The initial tools-only warmup was void because the writer changed source during that preliminary build.
It supplies no final verdict. The final quick and heavy runs were valid.
Builds used `CAMCRAFT_NO_SEED=1 CAMCRAFT_NO_SCCACHE=1 RUSTC_WRAPPER= CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0`.

Goldens moved: None.
The catalog passed all 33 active tests. The four undercut CL goldens passed.
The diff changes no `.nc`, `.cl` or `examples/catalog/**` file.
No recorded program needed regeneration.
No screenshot, log, review evidence or process file is committed in this round.

## Not exercised

The release gate, Windows, macOS and a real EDM control were not exercised.
This round adds no UI control or screenshot. The existing screenshot links remain above.
The knowledge graph update could not run because `graphify` is not installed on this host.
Positive-radius vector orbits with outlines are refused.
Their directions do not prove reach on angled walls.
A round gap can still leave a recess at a sharp corner.
The wall law does not change that geometry or the stock tolerance.
The independent stock verdict judges the burn.

Effort: high

Changelog: Sinker Burn judges stated cavity outlines on wall offsets, permits derived diamond finish electrodes, and refuses oversized electrodes by name. Undercut stock checks use exact disc-polygon intersection. Lollipop profiles draw the full ball united with the neck. Lollipop records refuse a neck that ends below the ball top.

Fixes #1810
